sources.title: GitHub - lightonai/LightOnOCR: Turn document pixels into structured ...
sources.snippet: The client reads the model name from the server and picks the page size, sampling and modes to match. With a custom --served-model-name, it assumes LightOnOCR-3 at 2048 px. --longest-edge overrides the page size.

sources.title: LightOn open-sources LightOnOCR-3 in 0.8B, 1B and 4B sizes under Apache ...
sources.snippet: Three models at 0.8B, 1B and 4B under Apache 2.0, commercial use allowed; the 0.8B and 4B move to the Qwen3.5 vision-language architecture. olmOCR-Bench overall: 86.3 for 4B, 85.5 for 0.8B and 84.5 for 1B, against 87.6 for the 35.1B-parameter Infinity Parser Pro.
